fields.label: Enable GVMS Connector
fields.description: Master switch for the connector. Leave unchecked to use the app as manual records only.

fields.label: API Gateway Endpoint
fields.description: GVMS does not publish a public REST API. Point this at a gateway/middleware endpoint (yours or the government's, when available) that exposes the app's expected JSON shape. See docs/10-fleet-management-reference.md.

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: Gateway key sent as the X-GVMS-Key header. Stored as a password field; never leaves the system.

fields.label: Organization Code
fields.description: MDAC/county code on the GVMS registry.

fields.label: Synchronise Vehicles
fields.description: Push the local vehicle registry to the gateway.

fields.label: Synchronise Fuel Logs
fields.description: Push submitted fuel logs to the gateway.

fields.label: Synchronise Maintenance
fields.description: Push submitted maintenance records to the gateway.

fields.label: Synchronise Vehicle Locations
fields.description: Hourly GPS pull for vehicles with a tracking device id.
